D1.name: Hiring Readiness Optimization
D1.comparative_analysis: Plan 1 integrates interview preparation (DSA, behavioral, system design) from Month 1 and maintains it consistently throughout all 6 months, with explicit LeetCode targets per month and mock interview sessions in Month 6. Plan 2 defers all interview prep to Month 6 (weeks 21-24), which is a significant structural weakness — a final-year student targeting global remote roles needs sustained DSA practice, not a last-minute cram. Plan 1's capstone project evolves progressively from Month 1 through Month 6, culminating in a deployed, Dockerized REST API with cloud hosting — a strong employer signal. Plan 2 also builds toward a portfolio project but starts it only in Month 5 and lacks the same deployment depth and continuity. Both plans cover the core CV technical stack (OpenCV, PyTorch, CNNs, object detection, segmentation), but Plan 1 integrates MLOps (MLflow, W&B, Docker, FastAPI, cloud) more deeply and earlier. Plan 2 covers similar ground but more superficially in Month 5.
D1.winner_reason: Plan 1's consistent DSA/interview prep across all months and its progressive, deployed capstone project are materially stronger hiring signals than Plan 2's deferred interview prep and late-stage project work.

Plan 1's monthly hour totals (~81-82 hours) align well with 4 hours/day over ~20 working days. Plan 2's Month 1 is notably dense — covering Python advanced topics, NumPy/Pandas, math foundations, ML basics, Scikit-learn, Jupyter, Matplotlib, and evaluation metrics in 4 weeks — which is cognitively ambitious. Plan 1 also has some density in early months but is more focused per week. Both plans avoid truly unrealistic advanced topics for the timeline, though Plan 2's inclusion of GANs and Vision Transformers in Month 4 Week 16 is somewhat superficial and adds breadth without depth.
D2.winner_reason: Plan 1's explicit hour budgeting with buffer, and more focused weekly scope, makes it demonstrably more feasible and accountable than Plan 2's unquantified schedule.
